FAQ

Common questions.

Do I need to know the terminal?
No. Every answer includes click-by-click steps using the normal desktop menus, so you can skip the terminal entirely.
What kinds of problems can it help with?
Finding files, disk space, permissions, processes and services, packages, networking and cleanup.
Is what I enter stored?
No. Your question is used to write the answer and isn't kept afterward. See the Privacy Policy.
What does it cost?
Linux Helper is part of Workblox Personal. You pick your tools and pay by how many: $10/mo for 1–2 tools, $15/mo for 3–4 tools, or $20/mo for 5–7 tools, with a 7-day free trial.
